description:
Submit authorized applicant details and documents for carrier registration.

        Submission is irreversible once sent for review. Carriers retain submitted documents.
        Applicant answers, address and documents follow the carrier's current
        requirements for the chosen applicant type and registration purpose.
        Number registration needs the offer's quote ID. Toll-free texting needs the
        owned number's ID. The named applicant must authorize the filing.
        The user must review and approve SMS campaign text before submission.

        For billed workspaces, an offer available for automatic purchase requires credit for
        the setup fee plus first month. Hail reserves that amount during review and
        applies it to a purchase using this registration. Hail releases the hold
        after rejection, cancellation or 30 days without purchase following approval.
        ``purpose="sms"`` registers US local numbers for US texting with carrier filing fees.
        Free toll-free verification uses type ``toll_free``, country ``US`` or ``CA``, the
        owned ``number_id`` and ``registration_kind=toll_free`` among the form fields.

        Inline files are included in the tool call and base64 adds about a third
        to their size. Decoded inline files total at most 29 MiB. The API also
        limits the combined file size, including uploads, to 30 MiB.
        The form accepts at most 100 applicant answers. ``check_verification``
        can preflight the same form without filing.

        Returns ``id``, ``state`` and ``subject_name``. Carrier review takes business days.
        A duplicate registration can return 409. A timeout can leave a submission in progress.
        Carrier field errors include ``problems`` and leave no saved submission.

city.description: City or town as it appears in the applicant's mailing address.
city.title: City

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the street address, such as `94103`.
postal_code.title: Postal Code

region.description: State, province, or equivalent administrative area in the applicant's address.
region.title: Region

address.description: The applicant's address. Give it when the requirements include one; otherwise leave it out.
address.title: Address

attest_authorized.description: Confirms that the applicant supplied the details and files and authorized this filing. Hail sends the filing only when this is ``true``.
attest_authorized.title: Attest Authorized

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as ``US``.
country_code.title: Country Code

documents.description: Map from each needed document slot to ``{option, fields}``, with the option chosen from that slot in the requirements.
documents.title: Documents

fields.description: Applicant answers as text, keyed by the field names in ``get_verification_requirements``. Choice fields take comma-separated option keys.
fields.title: Fields

files.description: One file per slot being filled, keyed by the matching slot in ``documents``. Upload IDs come from ``create_file_upload`` with purpose ``verification_document`` and last one hour. The inline form suits small files. Each file is at most 10 MiB.

slot.description: The key in ``documents`` that identifies what this file proves.

content_base64.description: Bytes of the complete document for this slot, supplied directly in the tool call.

content_type.description: Media type of the actual document. Hail checks it against the file bytes.

slot.description: The key in ``documents`` that identifies what this file proves.

files.title: Files

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

number_id.description: The owned number this registration is for: its ID from ``list_numbers``, the same one used for the requirements. Give it for toll-free texting and when the form asks for the sending number; otherwise leave it out.
number_id.title: Number Id

number_type.description: The kind of number this registration covers. Copy it from the offer in ``quote_numbers`` or the number in ``list_numbers``.
number_type.title: Number Type

purpose.description: What the registration is for: ``number`` registers the applicant so a number can be bought; ``sms`` registers US texting (local 10DLC or toll-free).
purpose.title: Purpose

quote_id.description: The number offer this registration lets the user buy: the offer's ``quote_id`` from ``quote_numbers``, the same one used for the requirements. Give it when ``purpose`` is ``number``; leave it out for ``sms``.
quote_id.title: Quote Id

subject_type.description: Who the registration is for, matching the requirements: the user (``person``) or their company (``business``). It has no default; without it, nothing is sent.
subject_type.title: Subject Type

name: submit_verification

anyOf.description:
A carrier verification: its state and the name of the person or
company it is for. No other personal data.

campaign_accepted.description: The carrier accepted the SMS campaign; this alone does not mean a number is ready to send.
campaign_accepted.title: Campaign Accepted

cancellable.description: True when `DELETE /v1/verifications/{id}` accepts this verification now.
cancellable.title: Cancellable

confirmation.description: For a person's US texting registration: 'code' when you must enter the code the carrier texted (POST /verifications/{id}/confirm), 'reply' when you must answer the carrier's text, null when nothing is pending.
confirmation.title: Confirmation

credit_needed_cents.description: The credit this registration still needs before Hail files its campaign, in US cents; null when `waiting_for_credit` is false. Per registration, not a running total: the first waiting registration shows the carrier's campaign fee less the credit left after the registrations already covered (more when the balance is short), each later one its whole fee. Add the sum over every registration with `waiting_for_credit` true, and one top-up lets them all go. It follows the balance, so read it again before you pay.
credit_needed_cents.title: Credit Needed Cents

identity_confirmed.description: True on a person's newest US texting registration when it is cancelled, or rejected and not yet dismissed, and the person stays confirmed: the next filing with the same first name, last name, email and mobile needs no code and has no submission fee. Dismiss a rejected registration first. Ignore it on older registrations.
identity_confirmed.title: Identity Confirmed

kept_until.description: For a number registration: when Hail deletes the answers and files it keeps so the filing can be fixed and sent again (30 days after submit). They go sooner when it is approved or cancelled, or the account closes. Null when nothing is kept.
kept_until.title: Kept Until

number_id.description: The owned number covered by toll-free SMS verification. Null for organization-wide registrations.
number_id.title: Number Id

purpose.description: 'number': permission to buy a number in this country. 'sms': US local texting registration or per-number US/Canada toll-free texting verification.
purpose.title: Purpose

rejection_reason.description: Why it was rejected. Null unless rejected.
rejection_reason.title: Rejection Reason

resubmittable.description: True when `POST /v1/verifications/{id}/resubmit` accepts this verification now: a rejected number registration whose answers are still kept (`kept_until`).
resubmittable.title: Resubmittable

runtime_ready.description: True when required runtime configuration was verified, false while setup retries, null when not independently tracked.
runtime_ready.title: Runtime Ready

step.description: For a US texting registration that is not yet approved or rejected: 'confirm_identity' while the person must confirm (see `confirmation`), 'filing' while Hail files the details with the carriers, 'carrier_review' once the carriers are reviewing them (1 to 7 business days), or runtime_setup when accepted but required messaging responses still need configuration; needs_information when the existing sender needs current campaign evidence before filing. Null otherwise.
step.title: Step

subject_name.description: Name of the person or company this verification is for, taken from the form (for example the business name, or the first and last name). Null when unknown.
subject_name.title: Subject Name

submitted_at.description: When it was submitted to the carrier.
submitted_at.title: Submitted At

waiting_for_credit.description: True when a US texting registration waits for credit: its next step, filing the campaign, has a carrier fee your balance does not cover. Nothing is filed until it does. Add credit; Hail goes on at its next check.
waiting_for_credit.title: Waiting For Credit

anyOf.title: VerificationResponse

problems.description: Validation issues with an input path and a message.
